 TASK: MAKING A POSTER TO EDUCATE ON DEVELOPMENTAL
 CHALLENGES DURING ADOLESCENCE
 Learners to work in groups to:
 a) source from printed and digital media information on how to make a poster that
 educates on developmental challenges during adolescence;
 b) make short notes on how to make the poster that educates on developmental
 challenges during adolescence;
 c) keep the information gathered and the short notes in a portfolio;
 d) share information collected, discuss and decide on procedures to follow to make the
 poster
 e) identify and collect materials they will require to make the poster;
 f) make the poster;
 g) display their finished product (the poster) in class for peer assessment;
 h) assess and reflect on their peers’ poster on the suitability of the messages to educate
 on developmental challenges during adolescence and make suggestions for
 improvement if any.
 The teacher to:
 a) comprehensively assess the suitability of the prepared poster to educate on
 developmental challenges during adolescence;
 b) orally ask the learners to explain to other learners how the material can be used to
 create awareness on the developmental challenges during adolescence.
